messages:
Alex G: Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained p95 spike on prometheus remote_write to the ingest cluster from the gpu-node pool. Grafana panel shows write lat up and a handful of 504s. https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/GPU/remote_write?orgId=1 :eyes:

sre-oncall-bot: [ALERT] prometheus_remote_write_latency_p95 (gpu-pool) firing — threshold 250ms exceeded (current 820ms). Ticket created: SRE-1429

Maria P: any logs from the pushgateway or prometheus side? could be network or upstream ingestion throttle.

Alex G: grabbing prometheus logs now, posting snippets.

Alex G: ```
level=error ts=2026-03-18T14:05:12.345Z caller=remote.go:322 component=remote write err="write request failed: server responded 504 Gateway Timeout"
level=warn ts=2026-03-18T14:05:13.120Z caller=client.go:210 component=remote write samples=12345 backlog=42
```

Cheng Li: 504 + backlog + high p95 usually means remote_write is overwhelmed or cardinality exploded and payloads got huge. did we recently ship any relabels or annotations to GPU pods?

Jess R: checked series count — there's a big bump in series for `pod` + `pod_annotation_*` labels around the same time. looks like a new annotation got attached to many training jobs (unique job run ids).

Maria P: do we have the scrape config relabeling to drop `pod_annotation_run_id`? GPU cluster config is older and misses some of the newer relabel rules we added for other clusters.

Alex G: confirmed. grep on prometheus config in k8s: 
```
- job_name: 'kubernetes-pods-gpu'
  kubernetes_sd_configs: ...
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_run_id]
    target_label: pod_annotation_run_id
```
no action to drop it. so that annotation is making each pod unique series.

Cheng Li: yep that's the explosion. short-term: drop the annotation label before sending to remote_write and add a relabel to remove it locally. proposed relabel_config:
```
- action: labeldrop
  regex: 'pod_annotation_run_id|pod_annotation_owner_id'
```
This will prune those dynamic values.

Jess R: can we patch the gpu prometheus kustomize to add that labeldrop? also patch servicemonitors for legacy stacks.

DevEx Bot: Suggested kubectl patch for the prometheus configmap (staging command):
```
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-gpu --patch '\"data\": {\"prometheus.yml\": \"(edited with labeldrop)\"}'
curl -s -X POST http://prometheus-gpu.monitoring.svc:9090/-/reload
```

Maria P: before we reload, confirm this won't drop any important debug labels. Are there metrics we rely on that use `pod_annotation_run_id`?

Jess R: negative — that annotation is only used by training job scheduler for ephemeral tracking, not by SLO dashboards. safe to drop for the scrape path.

Alex G: applying patch to canary prometheus in gpu-ops namespace now.

Alex G: ```
# patch applied
kubectl apply -f prometheus-gpu-relabel-patch.yaml
# trigger reload
curl -s -X POST http://prometheus-gpu.monitoring.svc:9090/-/reload && echo reloaded
```

ops-bot: Remote_write backlog for gpu-pool decreased from 42 -> 3 within 90s after reload. Alerts trending down. :white_check_mark:

Maria P: nice. can you throw the relabel change into a terraform/kustomize PR and target the other clusters? create a follow-up ticket for postmortem and alert tuning.

Cheng Li: also recommend we add a cardinality watch dashboard (series delta per 1m) and an alert for sudden per-job label cardinality increases.

Jess R: logging the candidate relabel snippet in the PR description and linking graphs. will handle the PR.

Alex G: filed SRE-1431 for the follow-up, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/812 

DevEx Bot: Reminder: run `promtool check config` on the patched config before rolling to prod.

Maria P: awesome teamwork. closing the immediate incident in a few minutes if no regressions. thanks y'all :heart:

Alex G: thanks — leaving notes in the incident doc with the command snippets and the grafana panel links.

sre-oncall-bot: [INCIDENT RESOLVED] prometheus_remote_write_latency_p95 (gpu-pool) — resolved after relabel patch and config reload.
